title: What Day Is It?

intro.title: Kimi's English Story Time
intro.sub: Episode 14 · What Day Is It? 🚌 (Season 2 Finale!)

intro.title: Last Time...
intro.sub:
Kimi had the best vacation ever and rode home on Mommy's back. 💗
Vacation is over — back to school, with buses, subways and calendars!

scenes.title: Walking to School
scenes.caption:
Twenty minutes of fresh morning air.
Walking makes us healthy!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Will you walk to school today? Hold my hand and walk.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: How long does it take by walking?

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: About 20 minutes. We can be healthy if we walk.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Want to sing while we walk? La la la! 🎵

scenes.title: The Green Light Rules
scenes.caption:
Red light, stop. Green light, go.
But always — ALWAYS — look both ways!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Stop in front of the crosswalk. Don't run in the crosswalk.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Mom, the light is green! Let's go! I hold my hand up when I cross! ✋

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Stop when the green light is flickering. Let's wait for the next light.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Mom, that car is running the red light! 😮

scenes.title: The Kind Bus Ride
scenes.caption:
Beep beep! The bus arrives.
And Kimi spots a grandma who needs a seat...

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let's check the route. What number bus do we need to take?

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: The bus is here! Let's get in! 🚌

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Grab the handle. ...Please give your seat to this lady.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Sit here, ma'am! 💺

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Good girl. Keep your voice down and behave on the bus.

scenes.title: Three Stops to Auntie's
scenes.caption:
Whoosh! The subway flies under the city.
Mind the gap, Kimi!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let's take the subway to visit your aunt. Step behind the safety line.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Mom, the train is coming! Is that the train we need to take? 🚇

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Get on after people get off. Watch your step when you get on.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: How many more stops are left?

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Three stops from here.

scenes.title: Tick Tock, Calendar Talk
scenes.caption:
Days, dates, hours, minutes...
Time is actually pretty fun!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: What day is it today?

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Today is Thursday. Tomorrow will be Friday — I like Friday the most, because I can rest the next day! 📅

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: What time is it now? The short hand tells you the hour, the long hand tells you the minute.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: It's four forty-five! And one second is like one blink of an eye! 😉

scenes.title: Subjects & Seasons
scenes.caption:
PE class, funny stories, and four
beautiful seasons to learn about!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: What is your favorite subject?

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I like PE class the most! And today the teacher told us a very funny story! 🏀

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Which season do you like the most?

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I love spring the most. The flowers bloom, and school starts in the spring! 🌸

songs: ⏰ Short hand = hour, long hand = minute

ending.title: You Did It, Kimi — All 14 Episodes!
ending.sub:
From sleepy mornings to big adventures,
Kimi's English grows every single day. Keep talking, keep growing! 💬🌱
